title: ✯ Roomy Walk-out Apt ✯ for Couples & Small Groups
description:
Only 15 mins from downtown & BNA, you'll pull down the driveway where you'll be able to load directly into your spacious, private lower level apt.

A living room, bedroom, kitchenette, bathroom, & laundry provided.

Furnished with new bedding, all memory foam. 2 queen beds in BR. Sofa bed. Will cradle ya'll well through the night. Rollaway on request.

4K 55" tv w/Netflix, Hulu, Disney+ & Nintendo.

Kitchenette includes fridge, filtered water, microwave, induction cook top, and a Keurig machine.

The space
Sleeping space includes 1 bedroom with 2 queen memory foam beds. In your living room there is a double bed and a sofa bed. Also, a comfy rollaway twin bed is available upon request.

Your private stay is full of commodities. 

A kitchenette with nice sized refrigerator, microwave, induction cooktop, and Keurig, along with full laundry is provided.

55” 4K TV with Max  and Nintendo Classic.

A sunroom with ping pong table is a shared space available to you too.

Also, a stylishly tiled shower with 3 shower heads to soothe your travel weary body.

Guest access
In addition to the private apartment, there’s a gas fire table, picnic area with pool in the backyard, and one off street parking space included. More parking available upon request.

Other things to note
Once you're booked, I'll send you a door code for easy access.
